info.title: Al Barakah MCSL API
info.description:
Internal operations API. Consumed by this application and, from Phase 4, by the member mobile application (AD-03).

This document is GENERATED from the route descriptors by `pnpm openapi:generate`. Do not edit it by hand.

message.description: Safe to show a person. Never contains internal detail.

correlationId.description: Ties this response to the server log.

details.description: Field-level messages, for validation failures only.

sessionCookie.name: ab_session
sessionCookie.description: The application's own signed session cookie, set by the OIDC sign-in flow.

memberToken.description: The member app's access token, from /api/v1/member/auth/verify-otp or /refresh. Resolves to a member_session server-side.

get.summary: Read one account's credits and debits
get.description: Every credit and debit recorded against this account, oldest first — not a running balance, and not a transaction history in the fuller sense: there is no ledger behind this account yet, only the payment that opened it and any refund paid back against it.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

get.description: Every role with the permissions it grants and how many people hold it. The count is what makes a refused deletion explicable.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

post.description: Creates a role and grants it permissions. An unknown permission code is refused rather than silently granting nothing.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

get.description: Every account, its roles, whether it is active, and whether the person has yet signed in — an account created by email binds to an Entra identity on first sign-in.

total.description: Accounts matching the search, before the cap.

truncated.description: True when the cap hid some of the matches.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against name and email. The response is capped at 100 accounts, so this is how a caller reaches the ones beyond the cap.

patch.summary: Change a user's roles or active state
patch.description: Roles are replaced wholesale, so the request states the intended final set. Deactivation never deletes: audit rows and approvals point at the person for longer than their employment lasts.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

roles.description: The complete intended set of role codes.

get.summary: Search for an existing member by name, NIC or Member No.
get.description: Matches active members only, for starting an additional-account application against one of them.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matched against surname, name, NIC and Member No.

get.summary: Search for a minor's guardian by name, NIC or Member No.
get.description: Matches existing active members and Individual applications not yet decided, so a parent joining alongside their child can be found before their own application is approved.

reference.description: Member No. once one exists, the application reference until then.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matched against surname, name, NIC and Member No./reference.

get.description: Membership types and their field rules, account types and which one a membership opens, fee schedules in force, document checklists, and the approval workflow with its statuses. Superseded fee versions are not included — a caller pricing an application wants what applies now.

isMembershipDefault.description: True for exactly one active type: the account a membership approval opens.

current.description: The version in force. Amounts are decimal strings, never numbers: money through a float is a rounding error waiting for a reconciliation to find it.

steps.description: Every step, disabled ones included. A caller running the chain uses only those with isEnabled true; an administration screen shows them all.

toStatus.description: Equal to fromStatus for a gate: a step that must be acted on but does not move the record.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

post.description: Records the intent to file a document and returns a short-lived, single-file upload URL. The caller never receives a credential, and never says where the file goes — the folder comes from the application or member it is filed against. Nothing appears on the checklist until commit-upload.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

expiresAt.description: Required for a document type configured to track expiry.

post.description: Asks SharePoint whether the file is present and complete. Only then is the document filed. A file that is absent or truncated leaves the checklist item as it was, which for a replacement means the document it was replacing is untouched.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

checksumSha256.description: Optional. Recorded so the archived file can later be proved unchanged (S-402).

post.summary: Get a short-lived URL to open a filed document
post.description: Returns a pre-authenticated URL good for one download, valid for a short time. The caller opens it directly — no further sign-in to SharePoint is needed or possible, which is what lets someone without a SharePoint account view a document at all.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

get.description: Returns events with a sequence number greater than `after`, oldest first. Record the highest sequenceNo you have processed and pass it back as `after` next time. Amounts are decimal strings, never numbers.

payload.description: The event in full: fee version, components, amounts, method and who recorded it. Self-contained, so a consumer never has to join back into tables that have moved on.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

get.description: Confirms the API is serving and the database is reachable. Requires a signed-in account: an open health endpoint tells an unauthenticated caller when the platform is degraded.

sharePoint.description: Whether the GRAPH_* settings are present in this environment. Not a reachability check — it makes no network call, so a health check does not depend on Microsoft answering.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

status.description: The application's workflow status. 'received' is submitted from the phone and with the branch.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

post.description: Captured by the member-app system user and tied to the verified mobile, which is pre-filled as the applicant's. One in progress at a time; a second is refused with the reference of the first.

status.description: The application's workflow status. 'received' is submitted from the phone and with the branch.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

status.description: The application's workflow status. 'received' is submitted from the phone and with the branch.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the bytes here, then commit.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

post.description: SharePoint is asked whether the file is there and complete; only then is it on the checklist. Only an upload begun on this application can be committed against it.

put.description: Never fails on content. Only parties the application has and fields the type configures are kept; the applicant's mobile is always the session's. Refused once submitted.

post.summary: Submit for the branch to take up
post.description: Refused with every blank mandatory field, unplaceable phone and missing required document named at once (details keyed subject.ordinal.fieldKey or document.<code>). On success the status is 'received'.

status.description: The application's workflow status. 'received' is submitted from the phone and with the branch.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

post.summary: Identify an existing member by NIC + AB Number and send a code to their registered mobile
post.description: Exact pair, active members only. The answer is the same whether the pair named someone or not — a challenge id and no number — so it never says whether a NIC + AB Number combination exists; a miss gets a challenge nothing can verify against. Rate-limited per NIC, per AB Number and per address, and one code per AB Number per cooldown window.

sentTo.description: Masked, e.g. +2305xxx234, for a sign-up. Always null for a link: the code went to the mobile on record, and saying which would confirm the pair named someone.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

abNumber.description: The Member No. on the card, e.g. AB0001.

post.summary: Revoke the session; the device must link again

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

post.description: A new access and refresh token; the one presented is dead the moment it is used. Refused once the session is revoked, expired, or belongs to a member who is no longer active.

429.description: Rate limited. See the retry-after header.

500.description: Unexpected failure. Quote the correlation id.

post.summary: Send a fresh code for a challenge already issued
post.description: Same purpose, same number; the previous code is dead.

sentTo.description: Masked, e.g. +2305xxx234, for a sign-up. Always null for a link: the code went to the mobile on record, and saying which would confirm the pair named someone.

post.summary: Verify a mobile number to start a membership application
post.description: No AB Number needed. Always succeeds for a well-formed number, known or not; the session it leads to never resolves to a member record.

sentTo.description: Masked, e.g. +2305xxx234, for a sign-up. Always null for a link: the code went to the mobile on record, and saying which would confirm the pair named someone.

mobile.description: Any form the capture form accepts; stored as E.164.

post.summary: Verify the code and create the session
post.description: Five wrong codes burn the challenge. The internal member id is linked to the session server-side and never returned.

put.description: Every mandatory field must be present and every phone placeable; details are keyed subject.ordinal.fieldKey. The mobile the member signs in with cannot be changed here. One request may wait at a time.

get.description: Active membership types with their field configuration, the documents an applicant files from the phone (the signed form is a branch step and is left out), and the fees in force. Public.
